arootah-arootah:lever:a71330c1-d201-43a9.title: Chief Operating Officer – Alternative Investments – Client Role
arootah-arootah:lever:a71330c1-d201-43a9.description: About the Role Our client, a rapidly growing alternative investment manager, is seeking a Chief Operating Officer to partner closely with the CEO in building the operational infrastructure needed to support the firm's next phase of growth. This executive will lead the firm's operational strategy, governance framework, and business infrastructure, ensuring the organization is positioned to scale efficiently across multiple investment strategies. The ideal candidate combines institutional investment management experience with a proven ability to build processes, optimize operations, and translate strategic vision into disciplined execution. This is a highly visible leadership role offering broad responsibility across operations, technology, finance, risk, investor operations, and organizational development. Partner with the CEO to execute the firm's long-term operational strategy and organizational objectives. Design and implement scalable governance frameworks, operating models, and decision-making processes. Build and enhance operational infrastructure across investment operations, finance, technology, investor operations, compliance, and corporate functions. Drive firmwide process improvement initiatives, identifying opportunities to automate workflows, improve efficiency, and reduce operational risk. Develop policies, procedures, and operating standards that promote accountability, consistency, and operational excellence. Evaluate and oversee technology platforms supporting investment management, CRM, reporting, document management, and business operations. Establish key performance metrics and management reporting to support strategic decision-making. Manage critical vendor relationships and oversee third-party operational service providers. Ensure the firm's operating platform is positioned to support future fund launches, new investment strategies, and continued business growth. Foster a collaborative, high-performance culture focused on execution, continuous improvement, and organizational scalability. 12+ years of leadership experience within investment management, hedge funds, private equity, venture capital, or institutional asset management. Previous experience as a Chief Operating Officer, Head of Operations, Chief of Staff, or similar senior operational leadership role preferred. Demonstrated success building and scaling operational infrastructure within a growing investment organization. Strong understanding of investment operations, fund administration, portfolio management systems, CRM platforms, operational technology, and governance best practices. Experience designing scalable business processes, organizational structures, and operating frameworks. Familiarity with SEC-registered investment advisers and the regulatory environment supporting alternative investment managers. Proven ability to lead cross-functional initiatives involving operations, finance, technology, legal, compliance, and investment teams. Exceptional leadership, communication, organizational, and problem-solving skills. MBA or other advanced degree preferred. Additional Information We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support portions of the hiring process, including resume review and candidate evaluation. These tools assist our recruiting team but do not replace human decision-making. Final hiring decisions are made by human reviewers.

cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:a99f6d9c-82a5-43.title: Controller, Family Office
cimgroup-cimgroup:lever:a99f6d9c-82a5-43.description: ABOUT THE COMPANY: Orchard Capital is a private investment and single family office platform dedicated to building and preserving long-term value through strategic investments, active ownership, and disciplined financial stewardship. The firm oversees a diverse portfolio of private companies, real estate investments, partnerships, trusts, and affiliated investment structures. With an entrepreneurial mindset and a long-term investment horizon, Orchard Capital partners closely with ownership, executive leadership, and trusted advisors to manage capital, pursue growth opportunities, and support the financial and operational success of its investments. Our culture emphasizes integrity, accountability, collaboration, and a commitment to excellence in everything we do. POSITION PURPOSE: The Controller, Family Office is responsible for the financial management, accounting, treasury coordination, tax support, and operational administration of a portfolio of private entities, partnerships, trusts, family office structures, and affiliated investment holdings. This role oversees day-to-day accounting activities, liquidity management, capital transactions, tax coordination, financial reporting, and special projects while serving as a key liaison to internal stakeholders and external advisors. The Controller ensures accurate financial records, timely reporting, and effective administration of complex ownership and investment structures.
responsibilities: Accounting and Financial Reporting
Maintain the books and records for multiple entities, partnerships, trusts, and ownership structures.
Serve as primary administrator for NetSuite and drive process improvements
Oversee monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.
Prepare and review financial statements, general ledger activity, reconciliations, and supporting schedules.
Ensure  timely  and  accurate  financial reporting across all assigned entities.
Maintain annual trial balances and supporting documentation.
Coordinate annual audits and other financial reporting requirements.
Treasury, Liquidity and Capital Management
Monitor cash positions and liquidity requirements across multiple entities.
Coordinate capital contributions, distributions, and  intercompany  transactions.
Review and process capital call requests and funding requirements.
Assess  anticipated  cash requirements related to tax payments, investments, and distributions.
Facilitate wire transfers and related cash management activities.
Maintain ownership schedules, capital account records, partnership allocations, governing documents, and organizational records across all entities and investment structures.
Tax Coordination and Compliance
Coordinate with external CPAs and tax advisors  regarding  entity, partnership, trust, and individual tax matters.
Review annual 1040 and other tax filings prepared by external providers.
Coordinate quarterly estimated tax payments.
Real Estate and Asset Management Support
Oversee financial administration related to privately held real estate assets.
Coordinate property tax payments, insurance matters, and related financial obligations.
Partner with internal and external teams to ensure proper accounting and reporting of asset activity.
Manage annual K-1 collection, tracking, review, and distribution to ownership and other stakeholders.
Monitor recurring regulatory and administrative obligations across all entities.
All other duties as assigned.
qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Accounting , Finance, or related field.
Minimum  7  years of accounting, finance, family office, private company, or investment management experience.
CPA designation  strongly  preferred.
Public accounting experience preferred.
Experience with NetSuite as an end-user  required .
Experience with partnerships, trusts, private investment structures, and multi-entity accounting.
Experience supporting high-net-worth individuals, family offices, private businesses, or investment organizations preferred.
Real estate, private equity, or alternative investment experience preferred.
Strong accounting and  financial management   expertise  with exceptional attention to detail.
Ability to  operate  independently while managing multiple priorities across complex entity structures.
Demonstrated  ownership  mentality and accountability for financial accuracy and timeliness.
Strong relationship-building skills with principals, executives, advisors, and service providers.
Proven ability to exercise discretion and handle highly confidential information.
Continuous improvement mindset and curiosity around AI with experience enhancing processes, controls, and reporting.

claspgroup-clasp-group:ashbyhq:9425f592-.title: University Partnership Development Associate
claspgroup-clasp-group:ashbyhq:9425f592-.description: University Partnership Development Associate Location Open to Remote in ET or CT Locations ONLY About Us Clasp is a mission-driven, venture-backed startup transforming access to education and career pathways—starting with the healthcare workforce. By enabling employers to invest in future talent where it matters most—easing overwhelming student debt—our platform creates lasting bonds between employers and employees. We believe that when employers have a stake in the cost of education, we can create a more sustainable, equitable, and skilled workforce. Fresh off our Series B, we’re entering our next phase of growth. Clasp is a Forbes Fintech 50 company, an SHRM portfolio company, and has been named by Business Insider as one of the “Top 14 Healthcare Startups to Watch in 2026” and one of the “43 Startups to Bet Your Career On in 2025.” We’re not just building a fintech product—we’re driving economic mobility. If you’re excited to build, grow, and make a real impact, join us. What We Need The Business Development Rep at Clasp is responsible for building relationships with Universities to develop deep partnerships and build awareness for Clasp. You'll build and manage a portfolio of school and program partnerships — engaging program directors, career services contacts, and financial aid offices to secure active, ongoing communication of Clasp opportunities to their students. This is a true high-volume sales job: 60% of time to be spent on cold outreach, and 40% on building/developing/nurturing existing relationships – with clear weekly and quarterly targets. You'll spend most of your time on the phone and in virtual meetings with school contacts, managing a pipeline of partner institutions from first outreach through active distribution. The role is also up to 40% travel - with the expectation that you’ll go visit schools in person to meet with administrators and students, as well as attend career fairs. There is also a requirement to travel to full company meet ups 3x per year. What You’ll Do - Conduct one-on-one calls with school administrators, program directors, and career services contacts per week - Execute daily outbound outreach to schools and programs (calls, email sequences, follow-ups) to build new distribution partnerships, resulting in a targeted number of new applicants sourced per week - Create plans with schools to share Clasp opportunities with their students and follow through to confirmed distribution - Execute campus visits, career fairs and virtual lunch & learns - Secure testimonials per quarter from satisfied partner institutions - Explore deep, creative partnerships with schools to build a strong foundation for Clasp pathways - Maintain accurate records of all school and student interactions in CRM, tracking commitment status and distribution evidence - Partner with Marketing to develop role-based assets (landing pages, co-branded materials, social graphics) that improve school distribution and student conversion - Report on outreach activity, pipeline health, and application volume on a regular basis What You’ll Need - Scrappy, resilient, positive attitude - 2–3+ years of experience in outreach, business development, partnerships, or higher-ed engagement - Comfort with high-volume outreach and structured follow-up (calling + sequencing) - Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including storytelling and persuasion / sales skills - Strong relationship-building skills with school administrators, program directors, and career services contacts - Organized and data-fluent: able to use CRM dashboards to prioritize work, track outcomes, and report clearly - Familiarity with HubSpot or similar CRM - Experience partnering with marketing teams on conversion-driving assets and messaging What We Give In Return - Competitive cash and equity compensation - Health benefits (health, dental, & vision), 401k - Commuter benefits - Flexible PTO policy - Opportunities to grow and perform in a fast-paced environme

jobgether-jobgether:lever:798dea79-39d1-.description: This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Team Lead Product Analyst based in India. This is a growth-oriented product analytics leadership opportunity for an experienced analyst ready to expand their impact beyond hands-on analysis. You will initially focus on product and business analytics while progressively taking ownership of larger analytical initiatives, stakeholder relationships, and team leadership responsibilities. The role sits at the intersection of Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and business strategy, giving you broad visibility into how data drives decisions. You will investigate complex product and business questions, identify opportunities, and translate insights into actionable recommendations. Over time, you will mentor analysts, shape analytical standards, and develop the skills required to lead a product analytics function. This is an ideal environment for someone with strong analytical and business judgment who is motivated to grow into a people leadership role. Investigate changes in product, marketing, and business KPIs, identify root causes, and translate findings into clear business recommendations. Conduct user behavior, funnel, retention, cohort, and segmentation analyses to understand product performance and customer behavior. Design, evaluate, and interpret experiments, including A/B tests, CUPED/CUPAC methodologies, and the use of proxy metrics. Quantify the expected and actual impact of product and marketing initiatives and communicate findings to relevant stakeholders. Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Growth, and other business teams to support data-driven decision-making and influence roadmap priorities. Generate actionable insights that help improve product performance, customer engagement, retention, and business outcomes. Work with Data Engineering to define analytical requirements, improve data quality, and strengthen the reliability of analytical datasets. Contribute to analytics infrastructure, dashboards, reporting processes, and metric systems to make insights more accessible and consistent. Help establish analytical standards, best practices, and reliable definitions for key product and marketing metrics. Support marketing and growth analytics, including LTV, CAC, attribution, funnel measurement, performance analysis, and optimization. Develop and validate leading indicators and proxy metrics that enable faster and more informed business decisions. Gradually take ownership of larger cross-functional analytical projects and drive them independently from definition through delivery. Mentor and support junior analysts, sharing analytical expertise and helping strengthen team capabilities. Participate in analytical planning and prioritization while developing stronger stakeholder management and communication skills with senior business leaders. Progressively take responsibility for analytical processes, quality standards, and team performance as preparation for a Product Analytics Team Lead position. Requirements Strong professional experience in Product Analytics, with a track record of using data to influence product and business decisions. Advanced SQL and strong data analysis capabilities. Hands-on experience with product metrics, funnels, retention, cohort analysis, experimentation, and growth analytics. Strong business and product thinking, with the ability to connect analytical findings to commercial and strategic outcomes. Ability to translate complex datasets and analysis into clear, actionable recommendations for both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills, with confidence collaborating across Product, Marketing, Growth, Data, and senior leadership. Strong ownership mindset, independence, and the ability to take analytical projects from problem definition through implementation and impact measurement. Genuine interest in me

labhouse-labhouse:ashbyhq:ea18c7cd-95a9-.description: Labhouse is a fast-growing startup that builds, launches, and scales its own AI & Productivity Apps, operating under a subscription-based business model. Based in Barcelona, Labhouse was founded by Andrés Bou and Horacio Martos (Co-Founders of SocialPoint). We operate at the intersection of mobile technology, AI, and product-driven growth, with a strong focus on experimentation and performance. Would you like to make an impact as part of a company that builds the best mobile apps used by millions of users worldwide? If so, discover your next challenge below. ABOUT THE ROLE: As a Marketing Video Editor, you'll create video ads for TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook that drive app downloads across our portfolio of apps. Your job isn't just editing, it's understanding what makes someone stop scrolling, watch, and click install. You'll join a team of 5 video editors producing close to 80 videos a week, constantly testing new formats, hooks, and styles using both classic editing tools and AI-powered creative tools. RESPONSABILITIES: - Execute and produce videos based on ideas aligned with Creative Strategists, both brand-new concepts and iterations or small changes to existing ads. - Create video content using AI, researching and applying best practices to get the best results, and constantly testing new AI technologies. - Constantly test new formats, hooks, and styles to find what performs, using both classic editing tools and AI-powered creative tools. - Proactively propose and test new video ideas without waiting to be briefed. - Challenge briefs by asking sharp questions about the product and users, rather than just executing them. ABOUT YOU: Academic background: - No specific degree required. We care about your portfolio and results, not your diploma. Technical expertise: - Solid portfolio of social media ads (TikTok/Instagram/Facebook) that have driven real app downloads or performance results. - Strong grasp of what makes short-form video work: hooks, pacing, retention, CTAs, and an understanding of current trends. - Comfortable with Adobe Premiere and After Effects. - Hands-on experience with AI creative tools (Seedance, Veo3, Kling, ElevenLabs, NanoBanana, Claude Design and ChatGPT), with real examples of AI-generated creatives you've shipped. - Comfortable working with different editing techniques: greenscreens, screen tracking, motion graphics, etc. Problem-solving and product focus: - A natural problem-solver with a strong visual sense: you know how to turn a tough brief or a raw idea into an ad that actually looks great and performs. - Self-driven, entrepreneurial attitude with the ability to work autonomously and take ownership of projects. - Critical eye: able to judge whether a creative will actually perform, not just whether it looks good, and comfortable reading and interpreting ad performance numbers. Communication: - Good level of spoken and written English and Spanish. - Collaborate and communicate within the video editors team: comfortable asking for and offering help, and quick to adapt to our internal ways of working. NICE TO HAVE: - Experience specifically in app marketing or performance marketing environments. WHAT WE OFFER: - Remote work from anywhere in Spain. If you are based in Barcelona, we would love for you to join us at the office (Barcelona Tech City) at least two days a week. - Flexible working hours. - Competitive compensation - High-end equipment for your development. - Permanent contract with competitive compensation. - A young and top entrepreneurial team in a dynamic startup environment. - Opportunity to lead, grow, and take on big challenges. - Work with cutting-edge technologies, including the chance to integrate AI models into new apps. msgentertainmentholdingsllc-msgentertain.description: Madison Square Garden Entertainment Corp. (MSG Entertainment) is a leader in live entertainment, delivering unforgettable experiences while forging deep connections with diverse and passionate audiences. The Company’s portfolio includes a collection of world-renowned venues – New York’s Madison Square Garden, Infosys Theater at Madison Square Garden, Radio City Music Hall, and Beacon Theatre; and The Chicago Theatre – that showcase a broad array of sporting events, concerts, family shows, and special events for millions of guests annually. In addition, the Company features the original production, the Christmas Spectacular Starring the Radio City Rockettes , which has been a holiday tradition for more than 90 years. More information is available at www.msgentertainment.com . Who are we hiring? The MSG Security Supervisor will be accountable for providing exceptional guest experience throughout MSG’s venues as it relates to event or building security. This role will focus on partnering within Venues, and across functions, to get work done through others in a fast paced and dynamic environment. Success in this role is demonstrated by creating a safe and secure environment without sacrificing an exceptional guest experience, committing to continuous learning and development, and achieving business results. The MSG Security Supervisor will report into the MSG Security Manager. What will you do? Accountable for daily supervision and leadership of building and event security officers. Lead and develop front line colleagues ensuring employees are engaged, upbeat, and capable of delivering exceptional guest experiences in a safe and secure environment. Ability to work collaboratively with other departments to achieve company objectives , especially in emergency situations and times of crisis. Assess, train, evaluate, and coach front line colleagues utilizing previous experience and company provided programs . Responsible for various administration items such as scheduling, invoices, incident reports, daily reports, and documentation logs. Responsible for ensuring that security office space and equipment is prepared to support security operations. Works with adjacent teams to address maintenance, custodial, and facility issues and improvements. Addresses customer concerns, feedback and suggestions in a timely and efficient manner May be tasked with managing or supporting additional security programs that facilitate security operations such as equipment inventory, conducting security advances and walkthroughs for visiting VIP’s, improving team processes, completing long term projects, and representing security leadership to other internal teams . Supervise Security Officers and support personnel. Provide exceptional experiences for our guests, partners, and team members, including by adhering to our appearance and presentation guidelines while on-site. What do you need to succeed? The ideal candidate will have a minimum of 3-5 years’ supervisory experience (preferred union experience) in the security, law enforcement, or military field, and preferably have knowledge of events, sports, theatre operations, within an entertainment venue. Previous security experience required, prior service as a non-commissioned officer in the U.S. military responsible for leading small units, training, and managing others would be ideal. Candidates who have completed a minimum of 60 credit hours of college-level coursework (representing 2 years), or have shown similar self-development through certifications, trade school coursework, etc. are preferred. Excellent communication skills, ability to mobilize key stakeholders, and engage with all levels in the organization Must be able to successfully complete physical fitness examination. Demonstrated experience completing reports and documenting staff performance is essential Ability to engage and develop collaborative relationships and influence within team and across functions, even without direct reporting

thegialliancemanagementllccompany-thegia.description: Chief CRNA Opportunity The Specialty Alliance Ambulatory Surgery Center Large Advanced Private Practice group looking for a dedicated Chief CRNA to join our anesthesia team, providing superior care, working collaboratively with CRNA's, Physicians, and ASC staff. Position Highlights Team Lead Leadership Stipend Highly competitive compensation and sign bonus No call - No nights - No weekends - No holidays Flexible scheduling Independent CRNA practice model High degree of autonomy What You'll Do Provide anesthesia care for outpatient GI procedures Conduct pre-anesthesia evaluations and patient assessments Manage airway and anesthesia administration Monitor patients throughout procedures and recovery Collaborate with physicians, nurses, and support staff Maintain compliance with clinical and safety standards What We Offer Comprehensive benefits package Stable, respected practice Supportive team culture Strong operational support through GI Alliance Qualifications CRNA Eligible state license Excellent communication skills The Specialty Alliance - Powering the future of physician-led, multi-specialty care. Uniting and empowering the nation’s leading physician-led gastroenterology and urology practices through an exclusive alliance built for clinical excellence, growth, and exceptional patient care. Patients Come First. Every decision we make is anchored in strengthening patient care. Our physicians lead with a commitment to quality, access, and outcomes, and our shared infrastructure ensures they have the tools, data, and support to continually elevate care in every community we serve. A Physician-Led Organization at Every Level. Our model is built on physician leadership. Through our Physician Executive Committee, Regional Clinical Governance Boards, and Local Head Physicians, clinical decision-making remains with those who deliver care. This physician-led structure, supported by national-scale resources, preserves autonomy while strengthening specialty excellence. True Partnership That Enables Physicians to Focus on Patients. Instead of a traditional management model, we operate as a Management Services Organization (MSO). Our national infrastructure, which includes analytics, technology, revenue cycle, compliance, and operational support, reduces administrative burden so physicians can devote their time and expertise to patients. We enable, we support, and we align. We do not manage. Outcomes Matter. Our leadership is driven by the measurable value we deliver to physicians, practices, and patients. Our partnership-first approach, combined with data insights and operational strength, has fueled significant clinical, operational, and practice growth. As more top-tier physicians join our specialty-led ecosystem, we continue to expand access and raise the standard of specialty-care nationwide. Interested in learning more? We are just a click away. No pressure. Just information and a partnership built for physicians who want to lead the future of specialty care. Be empowered to make your best next career move! The Specialty Alliance is a physician-led Management Services Organization (MSO) that supports leading specialty practices with national-scale infrastructure, data, and resources. Our partnership model preserves clinical autonomy while enabling responsible growth and high-quality specialty care nationwide. To learn more about The Specialty Alliance, visit www.thespecialtyalliance.com . The Specialty Alliance Corporate Headquarters, 550 Reserve St., Suite 550, Southlake, TX 76092, USA The Specialty Alliance | GI Alliance | Urology Alliance

weloglobal-weloglobal:lever:0bfce19a-f59.description: Welo Data, part of Welocalize, is a global AI data company with 500,000+ contributors delivering high-quality, ethical data to train the world’s most advanced AI systems. We’re building smarter, more human AI with a diverse community in 100+ countries. At Welo Data, Limitless AI. Limitless You. isn’t just a slogan—it’s our promise. We build smarter AI through the power of human contribution, offering limitless opportunities for our global community to grow, contribute, and work on their terms. Are you detail-oriented and curious about tech? Welo Data is building a global network of linguists, language enthusiasts, and culturally aware contributors to shape safer, smarter AI. By joining our talent community, you’ll be first in line for flexible, remote projects in annotation, evaluation, and prompt creation—always on your terms. Note: This is not an active job opening. By applying, you’ll join our global contributor network. When a project aligns with your skills and availability, we’ll reach out with all the details, including scope, timeline, and compensation. What You’ll Need - Native or near-native fluency in Russian - Based in: Georgia, Kazakhstan, Latvia, United States, Moldova, Kyrgyzstan, Turkmenistan, Uzbekistan, Tajikistan - English proficiency - Comfortable with digital tools - Detail-oriented and curious Why Join Us? 🚀 Limitless You – Work when and where you want, with room to grow 🤖 Limitless AI – Contribute to smarter, more inclusive AI 🌎 Be Part of Us – Join a global, supportive community About our projects: Welo Data projects vary by scope and complexity, but all play a role in building more accurate, inclusive, and human-centered AI. Depending on your skills, you might: 📝 Annotate or label text, images, or audio to train AI systems 🔍 Evaluate search results, ads, or chatbot responses for quality and relevance 💬 Create and test prompts to improve large language models (LLMs) 🌍 Ensure content reflects cultural, linguistic, or industry-specific accuracy Some projects last a few days; others may extend over several weeks. Before each one, you’ll receive clear details on tasks, timelines, and compensation, so you can decide what works best for you. How to Apply? Click the “Apply” button on our website to fill out a short form and join our talent database. It only takes a few minutes to get started and become part of our growing community. 📬 Questions? If you have any questions about the process, feel free to contact us at TalentRequests@welocalize.com.
